description: Find aircraft currently airborne in a geographic area, by bounding box. LIVE ADS-B data, no key required. Returns per aircraft: ICAO24 hex, callsign, registration (tail number), aircraft type, position, altitude, ground speed, heading, vertical rate, squawk, and any emergency code. Use for "what planes are over <place> right now", "aircraft near <airport>", "is anything squawking 7700 near X". For one known aircraft use get_aircraft; for what route a callsign flies use get_flight_route.

lamax.description: Maximum (north) latitude of the bounding box, degrees

lamin.description: Minimum (south) latitude of the bounding box, degrees

limit.description: Max aircraft to return (1-500, default 200), nearest the box centre first.

lomax.description: Maximum (east) longitude of the bounding box, degrees

lomin.description: Minimum (west) longitude of the bounding box, degrees

name: get_flights_in_area
